en.text:
Reloading after scoring Kills with the weapon overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.

Overfill amount maxes out at 150% of the Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up. Kill counter persists through stow.

Overfill amount per Kill scored:
• <primary/>Primary Weapons: 20%
• <special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons: 10%
